cards.back: Something we want to find out. Good science starts with a question.
cards.say: question. Something we want to find out. Good science starts with a question.

cards.back: What you think will happen, before you test it.
cards.say: prediction. What you think will happen, before you test it.

cards.back: A test where only one thing changes and everything else stays the same.
cards.say: fair test. A test where only one thing changes and everything else stays the same.

cards.back: Something that can change in a test.
cards.say: variable. Something that can change in a test.

cards.back: The tools you use, such as a ruler, scales or a thermometer.
cards.say: equipment. The tools you use, such as a ruler, scales or a thermometer.

cards.back: To find a size, mass, time or temperature using a number and a unit.
cards.say: measure. To find a size, mass, time or temperature using a number and a unit.

cards.back: What a measurement is counted in, such as cm, g or seconds.
cards.say: unit. What a measurement is counted in, such as cm, g or seconds.

cards.back: To look carefully and notice details.
cards.say: observe. To look carefully and notice details.

cards.back: To write down what you find out.
cards.say: record. To write down what you find out.

cards.back: The information you collect in a test.
cards.say: results. The information you collect in a test.

cards.back: A way to show results in rows and columns.
cards.say: table. A way to show results in rows and columns.

cards.back: A chart that uses bars to show amounts.
cards.say: bar chart. A chart that uses bars to show amounts.

cards.back: Something that happens again and again in your results.
cards.say: pattern. Something that happens again and again in your results.

cards.back: A sentence that says what your results show.
cards.say: conclusion. A sentence that says what your results show.

cards.back: To do a test again to check your results.
cards.say: repeat. To do a test again to check your results.

cards.back: Results you can trust because they are the same when repeated.
cards.say: reliable. Results you can trust because they are the same when repeated.

cards.back: Facts from a test that show whether an idea is right.
cards.say: evidence. Facts from a test that show whether an idea is right.

cards.back: To look at how things are the same and different.
cards.say: compare. To look at how things are the same and different.

cards.back: To put things into groups by what they are like.
cards.say: sort. To put things into groups by what they are like.

cards.back: Very close to the true value.
cards.say: accurate. Very close to the true value.

cards.back: Taking care so nobody gets hurt during an experiment.
cards.say: safety. Taking care so nobody gets hurt during an experiment.

cards.front: Why do we repeat a test?
cards.back: To check that the results are reliable.
cards.say: Why do we repeat a test? To check that the results are reliable.

cards.back: A thermometer.
cards.say: Which instrument measures temperature? A thermometer.

cards.back: Scales or a balance.
cards.say: Which instrument measures mass? Scales or a balance.

cards.front: What do we call the information collected in a test?
cards.back: Results, or data.
cards.say: What do we call the information collected in a test? Results, or data.
